title: Pi Toggles settings
description: Central capability policy, profiles, conditions, and session overrides for Pi.

$schema.description: JSON Schema used by editors for this settings file.

enabled.description: Enforce Pi Toggles policy while preserving the recovery command.

unknownCondition.description: Treat unknown or failed condition facts as a non-match.

showStatus.description: Show a compact footer status when policy changes Pi or has diagnostics.

path.description: Source-relative or canonical resource path to match.

state.description: Desired capability state. Available states depend on the capability kind.
